test_command: forge --version | grep -q 'Version: 1.8.1' || { echo 'focused gas evidence needs Foundry 1.8.1'; exit 1; }; CANDIDATE_RUN=1 forge test --match-contract '^(FocusedReleaseFlowTest|FocusedInventoryGasTest|InventoryBatchesTest|ERC20RecoveryTest|FactoryPauseTest|AuthenticRefundRecoveryTest|AuthenticEconomicFlowsTest)$' -vv

outcomes.text: Curated inventory operations return exactly two NFTs to the chosen creator in the reference roundtrip; native capital is unchanged and returned in full. Batches remain limited to 1 through 20 distinct IDs.
Exactly 1 WETH supplied by an external actor is recovered only to the current creator; external transfers create no separate depositor claim (R111).
Public creation remains paused while the policy admin creates and fully exits its own canary (R112).
A public caller refused by the creation pause moves zero native value.
The exercised reference roundtrips leave zero tracked inventory or recoverable ERC20/native assets; FWA proceeds and creator credit are zero at exit.
Each reference roundtrip returns all native principal; new inventory/ERC20 operations consume zero pool native capital. Gas paid by transaction senders is separate.
